name: Learn basic photography composition
blurb: Composition is what separates a snapshot from a photograph, and it costs nothing to learn. A phone camera is entirely sufficient.
steps: Learn the rule of thirds and use the grid overlay, then learn when centring is stronger.
Learn leading lines, framing, and the use of foreground to create depth.
Learn to simplify: identify the subject and remove everything that does not serve it, usually by moving your feet.
Learn to see light: direction, quality and colour. Shooting at golden hour instantly improves most photographs.
Learn to fill the frame and to watch the edges — distractions at the border ruin more shots than anything else.
Do a photo-a-day project for a month with a single constraint, such as one focal length or one subject.
tips: Zooming with your feet changes perspective; zooming with the lens does not. They are not the same thing.
The most common fix for a weak photo is to get closer.
proof: You can look at your own photo and say exactly why it works or does not, and then reshoot it better.
